serviceIdentification.serviceAcronym: Cyber AI Mission Defense and Email Protection
serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Darktrace Federal’s AI-powered solutions actively defend US Federal Government on-premises networks, cloud, OT, email systems, and zero trust architectures from cyber disruptions and ensure mission resilience. Rather than relying on signatures or historic attack data, Darktrace Federal's Self-Learning AI understands the normal operational behavior of each organization to identify unusual activities and autonomously respond in real-time. The Cyber AI platform consists of Cyber AI Mission Defense (CAMD) and Cyber AI Email Protection (CAEP) to form an adaptive knowledge of every device, user, peer group, network segment, and email communication. Together, CAMD and CAEP empower federal agencies to defend their digital ecosystems against sophisticated threats including nation-state attacks, insider threats, zero-days, phishing attacks and more.
